newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Duke Realty FY97 FFO upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Duke Realty FY97 FFO upped.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said Friday it raised its estimate of Duke Realty Investment Inc's funds from operations (FFO) for fiscal 1997 to $2.95 a share from $2.90 and increased its fiscal 1998 estimate to $3.25 from $3.12.
-- EVEREN cited Duke Realty's faster pace of new acquisition and development activity and higher than expected returns on new investments.
-- EVEREN also raised its six-month price target for the company to $42 and its 18-month price target to $45.
-- Duke Realty is a commercial real estate firm. Its shares closed down 1/8 Friday at 39-1/4.
